result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a loading spinner stuck over its hero image, which looks like an unfinished state. The search placeholder text is also faint. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are intentional and not reported.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, covering the food photo. It appears to be a loading state that never resolved or was left visible.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image has loaded, or show a placeholder or skeleton instead. Add a fallback so a failed image load does not leave a spinner over the content.

issues.description: The search placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray field, so its contrast is low.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color or the field background to meet at least WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) for text.
